{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast peaks by 5-15% after sharp upward spikes (e.g., >10% from prior day) to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if 3 consecutive days show model overestimating, reduce forecast by 2-5% per day.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (last 5 days) when sentiment is neutral, to avoid prolonged overvaluation.",
    "When sentiment turns positive (≥ 0.25), increase forecast volatility by 10-20% to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, apply a 3-5% downward bias if historical mean of true outcomes is consistently below model.",
    "If model consistently overpredicts in early days of a new trend (e.g., 1-3 days), apply a 10-15% correction to avoid lagged reaction."
  ]
}
